headline: Realty Income Tops Q3 Forecasts and Raises Outlook
summary: Realty Income reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, beating forecasts and raising its full-year guidance.
why: As a major real estate investment trust (REIT), Realty Income's performance and guidance provide key insights into commercial real estate health and dividend sustainability.
